newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Cimpor fixed assets re-valued higher.
newsitem.headline: Cimpor fixed assets re-valued higher.

text.p: Fixed assets of Portuguese cement firm Cimpor-Cimentos de Portugal were re-valued upwards by 107.1 billion escudos, an official company source said.
"Fixed assets were re-valued upwards by 107.1 billion escudos and amortisations grew by 12.2 billion escudos," the source told Reuters.
Net assets, excluding the effect of the extraordinary re-valuation, rose to 218.2 billion escudos in 1996 from 168.3 billion in 1995.
Fixed assets rose to 156.2 billion escudos in 1996 from 106.2 billion in 1995 and total equity rose to 193.2 billion escudos from 124.6 billion.
The source was speaking at the presentation of the company's 1996 results.
